## `BasicMetadata`

Source: [TagLibMetadataModels.swift:102](../../Sources/TagLibAudioMetadata/TagLibMetadataModels.swift#L102)

```swift
struct BasicMetadata: Sendable
```

> A normalized editing and display projection of commonly used metadata.
>
> Fields this model cannot express, including raw cardinality and supported
> container-specific entries, are preservation data rather than editable
> properties. Use `MetadataPatch`, Raw, or Structured APIs for precise edits.
> Normalized scalar projection of tag metadata.
>
> Multi-value fields such as `artist` and `genre` are display strings, not a
> stable array representation. Their separator is format-dependent
> (ID3 generally uses `", "`; MP4 artist/genre and generic/Xiph use `"; "`,
> while some MP4 native fields/freeforms use `", "`). Use `RawMetadataDump`
> or `StructuredMetadata` for lossless multi-value editing.

## `MetadataAudioContentIdentity`

Source: [MetadataAudioContentIdentity.swift:15](../../Sources/TagLibAudioMetadata/MetadataAudioContentIdentity.swift#L15)

```swift
struct MetadataAudioContentIdentity: Hashable, Sendable
```

> An opaque SHA-256 identity of encoded audio and its interpretation parameters.
> Known metadata is excluded, including WAVE `bext` / `iXML` and BWF time
> references; other ancillary changes can change the identity. It is not a
> perceptual fingerprint, a filesystem revision, or a cross-format recording identifier.
>
> Request it with `readSnapshot(from:includingAudioContent:)` or
> `readBasicSnapshot(from:includingAudioContent:)`. Availability is deliberately
> limited to native FLAC and single-data-chunk RIFF WAVE / AIFF / AIFF-C layouts.
> Do not infer continuity from two missing identities. Tokens are for in-memory
> comparison within this package version, not persistent identifiers.

## `MetadataFieldSchema`

Source: [MetadataFieldSchema.swift:194](../../Sources/TagLibAudioMetadata/MetadataFieldSchema.swift#L194)

```swift
struct MetadataFieldSchema: Identifiable, Hashable, Sendable
```

### Properties

```swift
var id: MetadataFieldKey
var key: MetadataFieldKey
var displayName: String
var category: MetadataFieldCategory

/// Stable semantic identity shared by presentation aliases. It is not the
/// engine PropertyMap key and may differ from the Swift case spelling.
var semanticKey: String

/// Display/import and engine PropertyMap aliases. Presentation names do
/// not create additional stored fields.
var propertyMapKeys: [String]

/// Explicit native read/write targets from the mapping catalog.
var nativeTargets: [MetadataNativeTarget]

var isMultiValue: Bool
var isPeopleField: Bool
var isRoleQualified: Bool
var isArtworkField: Bool

/// A concrete reason typed writes are withheld despite readable targets.
var writeUnsupportedReason: String?
var mappingContractVersion: String

/// A compatibility projection of the native target table in the older
/// format-mapping vocabulary. It is derived, never hand-maintained, so the
/// two views cannot drift.
var mappings: [MetadataFormatMapping]

/// Value representations accepted by the high-level typed patch API.
var acceptedPatchValueKinds: Set<MetadataPatchValueKind>

/// Numeric limits shared with the Objective-C++ bridge's integer validation.
/// MP4 pair components have narrower native limits; the planner applies
/// those per destination family.
var integerConstraint: MetadataIntegerConstraint?

var aggregateCapability: MetadataMappingCapability
```

## `MetadataPatchValue`

Source: [MetadataSnapshotPatch.swift:5](../../Sources/TagLibAudioMetadata/MetadataSnapshotPatch.swift#L5)

```swift
enum MetadataPatchValue: Hashable, Sendable
```

### Cases

```swift
/// Non-empty text. Leading and trailing whitespace is removed before mutation.
case text(String)
/// A schema-constrained integer. Track/disc pair components begin at one;
/// use `.remove` to unset them. Other numeric fields retain their schema ranges.
case integer(Int)
case boolean(Bool)
/// One or more non-empty values. Each value is trimmed before mutation.
case values([String])
/// Explicitly removes the field. Empty text and value arrays are not deletion aliases.
/// Removing one track/disc component preserves its sibling. MP4 uses
/// the native zero sentinel for an absent component; ID3 writes /total.
/// Layouts without a verified total-only codec reject that operation.
case remove
```

## `TagLibManagerError`

Source: [TagLibMetadataModels.swift:698](../../Sources/TagLibAudioMetadata/TagLibMetadataModels.swift#L698)

```swift
enum TagLibManagerError: Error, Sendable, LocalizedError
```

### Cases

```swift
case invalidFile
case fileChanged
case hardLinkedFile
case unsupportedFormat
case unsupportedWritePolicy(String)
case failedToReadWithUnderlying(String)
case verificationFailed([String])
/// Operation failure described by a caller-supplied message.
case operationFailed(String)
/// A pre-commit native or filesystem failure, retaining domain, code, and
/// nested causes for recovery decisions.
case operationFailedWithUnderlying(NSError)
/// Atomic rename completed, but the parent-directory fsync failed.
/// The new file is already visible and callers must not treat this as a pre-commit failure.
case committedButDurabilityUncertain(String)
```

### Properties

```swift
var underlyingError: NSError?

var errorDescription: String?
```
